page_title: VIL 2-1 OSA | Villarreal v Osasuna 20/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Luiz Junior. What a save!
90+3' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
90+3' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
90+2' Dangerous play by Asier Osambela (Osasuna). Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

89' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Villarreal can continue in their attacking effort.
88' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Flavien Boyomo is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
88' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but Luiz Junior makes a magnificent save!
87' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) sees a yellow card from Isidro Diaz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' 2 - 1 Goal! Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi unleashes a strike and Pape Gueye (Villarreal) deflects the shot into the net with his body. 2:1.
84' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) heads on.

83' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
83' A nice individual effort by Manor Solomon (Villarreal) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.

82' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
82' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
79' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies just over the crossbar, almost brushing it.
77' Here is a change. Victor Munoz is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna).
77' Ante Budimir goes off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on.
73' The referee blows for a cooling break.

72' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Sergio Herrera.
71' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.

69' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Manor Solomon. The score is now 1:1.
68' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post.
68' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
67' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Juan Foyth will be replaced by Renato Veiga (Villarreal).
67' Here comes a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is given a rest as he is replaced by Manor Solomon (Villarreal).
66' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz no option but to blow his whistle.
63' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
62' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Pape Gueye (Villarreal), whose header floated just over the bar.
61' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
61' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
58' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Santi Comesana (Villarreal) replacing Pau Navarro.
58' The referee signals a substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Partey.
57' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
53' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top right corner. Sergio Herrera has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
46' Half-time substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is replaced by Jorge Herrando.
46' The game is over for Juan Cruz (Osasuna). Asier Osambela comes on for the second half.
46' Tajon Buchanan comes onto the pitch after Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
46' Referee Isidro Diaz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Luiz Junior no chance!
45+5' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is going to take the penalty!
45+5' Referee Isidro Diaz is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna!
45+4' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Osasuna as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
45+3' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Thomas Partey (Villarreal). The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Osasuna!
45+1' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' The foul by Pau Navarro (Villarreal) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Isidro Diaz.
40' RED CARD! Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Isidro Diaz. He can have an early bath.
39' Isidro Diaz shows the yellow card to Lucas Torro (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.
36' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.

35' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.

35' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
33' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) has received a yellow card for his foul.

33' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera pulls off an easy save.
32' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul. Isidro Diaz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Osasuna, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
27' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz stops the game and makes a call.
26' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.
25' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
24' Luiz Junior is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Ante Budimir (Osasuna). Easy save!
22' Villarreal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
19' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 60:40.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
11' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
10' Some patient build-up play from Osasuna as they look to unlock the defence.
8' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
7' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
5' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' What an opportunity! Juan Cruz (Osasuna) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
2' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Isidro Diaz.
